outcome: perinatal composite outcome (respiratory insufficiency, intraventricular hemorrhage, culture-proven sepsis, Apgar score 3 or less at 5 minutes, phototherapy, and perinatal death)
time interval from discharge home to delivery
cohort: Women at 37 0/7 to 41 6/7 weeks of gestation without pre-existing medical complications who presented to the hospital-based triage unit with symptoms of labor and underwent a standardized evaluation.
finding: Discharge with false labor at term after a standardized assessment in a triage unit was not associated with increased rates of adverse perinatal composite outcomes or cesarean delivery.
